scope: standalone scoped candidate; formal GPU/composed scene NOT_RUN
reconstruction_notes: Skull lateral depth and tooth-size contrast informed by BMNH41212; BMNH43486 separate mandible; R1034 separate partial postcranium. BSP1994I51 excluded.
Three free manual digits plus one elongate wing-support digit on each forelimb are conservative pterosaur reconstruction, not a digit census from supplied slab.
Five pedal digits per foot: four shorter forward grasping toes and one longer posterolateral fifth; explicit artistic restoration independently reviewable, not measured from R1034.

Pose, proportions, skull breadth, living skin, eye and nostril placement, tail curve/length, membrane, palette and display dimensions are artistic. No preserved pigment, complete tail or habitual behavior claim.
No crest, feathers, naked fenestra holes, detached avian wing pair, ornamental tail vane, platform or copied fossil displacement.
Consulted source pixels and third-party geometry/textures are excluded; all target mesh vertices and palette materials authored by this generator.
author: Leon Made This / s010s
acceptance_scope: Original frozen scoped independent model review with retained advisories; no blanket formal/GPU/neighbor/reproducibility or user visual approval. Website image review remains separate.
scale_scope: Nominal authored display dimensions; not new specimen metrology.
